description: This Java class defines the Product entity used within the backend API to represent product records. It includes fields such as id, name, price, and quantity, with appropriate JPA annotations for ORM mapping. The class provides constructors, getters, and setters for these fields.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product with fields for id, name, price, and quantity, mapped to the 'products' database table.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all fields.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the available quantity of the product.
